description: This file implements a data structure for managing a dynamic vector of integers, including initialization, creation, addition, searching, removal, cleaning up unused entries, and destruction.

methods.name: void INT_VECTOR_Init(int_vector_t * iv)
methods.description: Initializes the integer vector structure by setting its internal pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: void INT_VECTOR_Create(int_vector_t * iv,int num_entries,int initial_value)
methods.description: Creates a vector with a specified number of entries, all initialized to a given value, allocating memory accordingly.

methods.name: void INT_VECTOR_Add(int_vector_t * iv,int number)
methods.description: Adds a new integer to the vector, reallocating memory in chunks to optimize performance.

methods.name: int INT_VECTOR_Find(int_vector_t * iv,int number)
methods.description: Searches for a specific integer in the vector and returns its index or INVALID if not found.

methods.name: void INT_VECTOR_Remove(int_vector_t * iv,int number)
methods.description: Removes all occurrences of a specified number from the vector, compacting the entries and freeing memory if the vector becomes empty.

methods.name: void INT_VECTOR_RemoveUnusedEntries(int_vector_t * iv)
methods.description: Removes all entries marked as INVALID and compacts the vector accordingly, freeing memory if necessary.

methods.name: void INT_VECTOR_Destroy(int_vector_t * iv)
methods.description: Frees the allocated memory for the vector and resets the entry count.
